entities.summary: Nelly Mukazayire is a Rwandan economist and public administrator, who served as the chief executive officer of the Rwanda Convention Bureau, a division of the Rwanda Development Board. she has been promoted to the post of the Deputy CEO of RDB in March 2023 where she was the deputy to Francis Gatare, the CEO of RDB. In September 2024 she was promoted to be the permanent secretary in the ministry of sports in the Rwandan government. In December 2024 she has been promoted as the minister of sports, where she has a mandate to implement the sports policy.
